title: A letter from National Prize Center
summary: This is a winner notice from National Prize Center. It says you have won $5,000. It asks you to send a $50 processing fee in gift cards and to call the number.
words:
NATIONAL PRIZE CENTER
Official Winner Notice
CONGRATULATIONS! YOU HAVE WON $5,000!
To claim your prize, send a $50 processing fee in gift cards within 24 hours.
Call the number now. Do not tell anyone until your prize arrives.
